finding.summary: 论文要求 FlashAttention 与 V 信息参与选择；代码为稠密权重计算且完全不含 V

paper.quote: approach leverages FlashAttention [ Dao24] to reduce GPU memory overhead and incorporates the informa- tion from the V matrix, enabling end-to-end selection of the best pattern, which further enhances performance.

analysis.tier_note: the reading and the probes disagree
analysis.reasoning: The cited code does contain an older search_pattern(q,k,head) that lacks V and uses dense qk weights. However, search_pattern_v2(q,k,v,head) accepts V, calls flash_attn_func for a dense reference, and scores candidates by comparing outputs, so V and FlashAttention participate in selection. Thus the broad claim that the code is dense-only and completely lacks V is contradicted.
analysis.would_confirm: Trace which search function is called at runtime and verify whether search_pattern_v2 with V and FlashAttention is used for pattern selection.
